chunks: I CALL TO WITNESS those who are sent consecutively,

key_terms.عُرْفًا: Consecutively, in an orderly manner, or according to custom
key_terms.وَالْمُرْسَلَاتِ: The sent ones (angels or messengers) who are dispatched

ai.seo_question: What does the oath by the 'Mursalat' (those sent consecutively) signify in Surah Al-Mursalat?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'Al-Mursalat' is often interpreted as referring to the angels who are sent with commands, or specifically to the Prophets and Imams who convey divine guidance in succession. This opening oath underscores the reliability of the message by linking the messengers' consistent arrival with the certainty of the Day of Judgment, a core tenet in Shia eschatology.
